title: Junior Project Engineer
abstract: Long term contract opportunity for a Jnr Project Engineer looking to develop their career with a global leader in the chemical / scientific industry.
content_text:
Our client is a world leader in the manufacturing of chemicals and scientific products. They employ thousands of people in R&D facilities across the globe and are committed to developing innovations that will make a difference to our world. They are currently seeking a Junior Project Engineer for a long-term casual role (with the view to permanency) in their manufacturing facility based in North West Sydney.
Duties include:
 - Project planning, ensuring timely completion and to specification.
 - Providing support to Project Managers.
 - Travel to local and international sites to supervise the installation of equipment.
 - Providing support and guidance to the company’s distributors, OEM’s and strategic partners.
 - Reviewing project drawings and liaising with the design team.
 - Selection of equipment components on suitability, price and availability.
 - Preparation of bills of materials as directed.
 - Preparation and issuing of specifications, analysing quotes and issuing purchase requisitions.
 - Preparation of data for progress / contract reviews.
Ideally you will have:
 - Tertiary qualifications in Mechanical Engineering.
 - A current passport and ability to travel locally and internationally at short notice.
 - The ability to work under minimal supervision and be self-driven.
 - Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
This is an excellent long term casual opportunity for a Junior Project Engineer looking to develop their career with a global leader in the chemical / scientific industry. The opportunity for permanency is also available for the right candidate.
To apply please submit a cover letter and resume in MS Word format.
